{{Draft}}
Every field of the [[Directory]] forms, in the order of the form. Field names are given as they appear in the forms; where a field appears under another name in some forms, that name is given in brackets. Fields filled in automatically (who created or changed an entry, and when) are not listed.

'''Input:''' ''text'', ''number'', ''tick box'', ''list'' (choose from a fixed list) or a link to another record. '''Required''' fields must be filled in before saving. Long lists are shown on the [[Field reference/Base tables|Base tables]] page.

== Main form ==
{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%"
! style="width:18%" | Field !! Meaning !! style="width:14%" | Input !! style="width:28%" | Values
|-
| '''Public''' || Tick to publish the entry. || tick box || 
|-
| '''TypeOfID''' || Person, private organization or public organization. || list<br />'''required''' || Person, Private organization, Public organization
|-
| '''Name 1''' || For a person: the first name. For an organisation: the full name. || text || 
|-
| '''Name 2''' || For a person: the surname. Empty for an organisation. || text || 
|-
| '''Alias''' || Short name shown in every list where the entry can be picked, and the directory is picked everywhere. Make it unique and recognisable. || text<br />'''required''' || 
|-
| '''Comments''' || Internal notes for editors. Not published. || long text || 
|-
| '''Piravte collection''' || Tick to keep the entry out of artists' lists of collections holding their works. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Provenance: private ?''' || Tick to keep the entry out of the ownership histories of all artworks. || tick box || 
|-
| '''transactions: private ?''' || Tick to keep the entry out of the sales records of all artworks. || tick box || 
|-
| '''Limited To Artist ID''' || Restricts the entry to one artist's catalogue; it is then invisible to all others. Use sparingly. || link to an artist || 
|}

|-
